meta.title: Become a member | Bitcoin Torino
meta.description: Bitcoin Torino is the association that brings together the Bitcoin community of Turin. Membership fee, member benefits, ways to take part and how to apply.

hero.title: Join Bitcoin Torino
hero.subtitle: Bitcoin Torino is the association that brings together the Bitcoin community of Turin: projects, companies, institutions and citizens who want to grow the Bitcoin ecosystem in the city. Becoming a member means taking part in this path.

fee.title: Membership fee
fee.description: The fee covers the current membership year and goes directly to the association's activities: events, cultural initiatives and educational work across the territory.
fee.validity: The fee is valid for the calendar year in which it is paid.

benefits.title: What you get as a member

items.title: Members' event
items.description: Attendance at the exclusive end-of-year event for members, dinner included.

items.title: Discounts on events
items.description: Reserved rates on events organised by the association.

items.title: Discounts on partner products and services
items.description: Access to preferential terms at the businesses partnered with Bitcoin Torino.

items.title: Governance
items.description: Voting rights in the General Assembly: you contribute to the association's decisions and elect the Board of Directors.

participation.title: Two ways to take part
participation.description: Becoming a member is not a single fixed commitment: you can choose the level of involvement that suits you best and change it over time.

observer.title: Observer member
observer.description: You follow the association's activities, take part in its social life and keep your voting rights in the General Assembly, with no direct operational commitment. Sharing ideas and contacts is welcome.

operational.title: Operational member
operational.description: On top of the observer member's benefits, you actively contribute to the life of the association. You can choose to lend a hand on one or more activities already planned, or to propose new initiatives.

meetings.title: Meetings
items: All members take part in the two half-yearly plenary meetings, the moments of discussion and update shared by the whole association.
Operational members also take part in working meetings, called as needed and dedicated to the activities under way.

join.title: How to apply
join.description: Joining the association takes two steps:
steps: Wait for approval from the Board of Directors
join.after: Once your application is approved, you will receive the instructions to pay the fee and to access the members' channels.
join.note: no document is required to apply. The data entered in the form is provided under the responsibility of whoever declares it; the Association takes no responsibility for its accuracy.

short.title: Short description
short.text: Associazione Bitcoin Torino brings together Turin's Bitcoin ecosystem and connects the city's businesses and institutions with industry players in Italy and abroad.

long.title: Extended description
long.text: Associazione Bitcoin Torino is a non-profit association founded in Turin in March 2026. It promotes the understanding and adoption of Bitcoin and of technologies that protect individual freedom and sovereignty. The association coordinates and represents Turin's Bitcoin ecosystem, made up of 31 businesses that accept bitcoin payments, 8 communities and several academic and entrepreneurial projects. It organises events and educational activities, supports businesses and individuals in the correct use and self-custody of bitcoin, and fosters dialogue between communities, industry players and city institutions. It connects the city's businesses and institutions with industry players in Italy and abroad, with the goal of making Bitcoin a pillar of the city's economy.

hero.title: Bitcoin Torino Help Desk
hero.subtitle: A free Bitcoin guidance service for people dealing with a real, ongoing problem. Tell us what is happening and we will help you understand what went on, what your options are and who to turn to.
hero.free: Free for everyone, members and non-members

what.title: What the Help Desk is
what.description: The Help Desk deals with real, ongoing problems, not basic training. It provides three things:

items.title: Documented information
items.description: Written, verifiable answers to the questions you send us.

items.title: Hands-on training
items.description: Dedicated sessions to tackle a specific operation or tool.

items.title: Referral to qualified parties
items.description: When a request falls outside our scope, we point you to the right people.

what.notConsulting: The Help Desk is not a consulting service, neither technical nor financial.

audience.title: Who it is for
audience.description: Each audience has different needs. Here are the problems we can guide you on.

items.title: Merchants and shops
items.summary: Accepting bitcoin payments in store or online.
topics: What you need to accept bitcoin payments
Training staff who handle payments
A real test payment during onboarding
Which questions to ask your accountant
Listing on the public map and shop-window materials

items.title: Non-retail businesses
items.summary: Receiving payments from clients and documenting transactions.
topics: Correctly receiving a payment from a client, including from abroad
Securely storing your treasury
How to technically document a received transaction
Which questions to ask your accountant
Overview of existing providers by category

items.title: Professionals
items.summary: Accountants, consultants and developers supporting their clients with tools and workflows.
topics: How to correctly handle custody and payments
Integrating payments into e-commerce sites
Which data is needed for reporting
Training sessions for professional firms

items.title: Organisations and associations
topics: How to receive bitcoin donations
Which data is needed for reporting
How to communicate it to your supporters

items.title: Private citizens
topics: Trouble accessing a wallet or a device
Payments that have not arrived, are stuck or incomplete
Doubts about how a device or app you already use works
Suspecting you are facing a fraudulent scheme
Documentation to present to your accountant

how.title: How it works
how.description: Send us an email describing the problem. Each request is routed to the most suitable lane:

lanes.title: Complex operational or tax request
lanes.description: We refer you to qualified partners.

lanes.title: Out of scope
lanes.description: We point you to useful materials.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Online or in person, shared on confirmation

limits.title: What we don't do
limits.description: These limits apply to everyone, with no case-by-case exceptions.
items: We do not operate on third-party devices, wallets or accounts
We never see, type or store seed phrases or private keys
We do not hold funds, collect payments on behalf of others or host infrastructure
We do not recover lost funds or intervene in stuck situations
We do not provide tax interpretation or fill in tax returns
We do not tell you how much to buy, hold or when to convert
We do not handle sign-ups with third-party providers or collect documents
We give no guarantees on how third-party services work
We do not deal with assets other than bitcoin

partners.title: Referral to partners
partners.description: When a professional service is needed, we refer you to external parties following three rules.

items.title: Never a single name
items.description: We provide at least two names per category, in alphabetical order. One name would be a recommendation, several names are guidance.

items.title: No compensation
items.description: Bitcoin Torino receives no fees, commissions or revenue share from the parties indicated, in any form.

items.title: Declared relationships
items.description: If a party indicated is a partner, supporter or funder of the association, we tell you during the session.

contact.title: Tell us your problem
contact.description: Write us an email explaining who you are and what you are facing. The more detail you give, the faster we can guide you.
checklist: Who you are: merchant, business, professional, organisation or private individual
The problem you are facing and since when
The tools involved: wallet, app, POS or provider
Whether you prefer an online or in-person session
contact.warning: Never send us seed phrases, private keys or passwords. Nobody at the Help Desk will ever ask for them.
contact.privacy: The Help Desk is run by the association's members, on a voluntary and free basis. No session is recorded and no data is collected.
contact.disclaimer: The information provided is for educational and informational purposes and does not constitute professional advice of any kind. Decisions and operations remain the responsibility of whoever contacts the Help Desk.
